why_agent_cannot: nothing - the domain is dead or looks like a scam
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://www.ithacaprotocol.io   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Ithaca Protocol site Go to the Ithaca Protocol site and press Launch App to reach the options trading app.
2 Step 2 : Look through the app views The Ithaca App section of the site shows Market, Stories, Position Builder and Dynamic Option Strategies. Read what each view does before placing any order.
3 Step 3 : Read the legal pages The app's Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions are linked from the site. Read them before using the app.
4 Step 4 : Find the project's channels The site links the project's X account and a Telegram chat.
